correctness.rationale: The exact beta eigenvalue formula and mode staircase yield a uniformly valid asymptotic maximizing index. The rescaled beta density tends locally uniformly to a gamma density for bounded positive index scale, giving the thin and critical-width regimes; beta--gamma representation plus divergent optimal index scale proves the broad-width limit 1. The statement covers arbitrary positive H(U) with the indicated ratio limits. Finite checker 618 assertions corroborate input identities, not the theorem.

originality.rationale: The earlier fixed-H exact annulus index and norm result is expressly excluded from novelty and used as a known lemma. The new single result is the complete three-way joint-scaling law for H(U)/U, especially finite positive gamma norm in the critical regime and norm tending to one in the wide regime. Neither the inspected Ramos--Tilli disk optimum and reversed-annulus problem nor Abreu--Dörfler radial diagonalization assert those scaling regimes. Full historical priority remains provisional because more general incomplete-beta asymptotics may contain them.
residual_risks: Known exact annulus beta index and fixed-H limit are not original; only the joint-scaling norm phase diagram is offered as new.
A uniform incomplete-beta distribution asymptotic in the broader literature could imply all three regimes.
Full Suarez article was not inspected.

value.rationale: The same natural hyperbolic annulus localization operator has three qualitatively distinct sharp optimal concentrations under joint growth of width and boundary distance, with exact nontrivial gamma probability at the transition. This determines which aperture scalings give vanishing, fractional, or nearly complete recovery for optimal analytic-wavelet modes. Prior fixed-area asymptotics do not solve the growing-width comparison.
